support.title: Support
support.howTitle: How it works, in one paragraph
support.howBody: A SplitViewer organizer connects their Splitwise account, picks a group, and gets a public link. Anyone with that link sees a read-only dashboard of open debts — first names and last initials only — grouped by currency, refreshed automatically roughly every 7 minutes while people open it. The organizer can revoke the link at any time; revocation is instant.
support.a1Before: Only if you create a share link for it. Creating or revoking a link is always under your control from
support.q2: Do viewers need a Splitwise account?
support.a2: No. The public page works for anyone with the link, including crawlers and messenger previews.
support.a3: Group name; open settlements as “First Name L. → First Name L.” with the amount; the currency of each block.
support.a4: Emails, avatars, full surnames, member ids, expense descriptions or receipts, invite links, or anything else from your Splitwise account. The stored snapshot contains only sanitized labels — nothing sensitive is persisted.
support.q5: How do I revoke a dashboard?
support.a5: Open your dashboard and press “Revoke”. The page, its cached snapshot, and the OG image stop responding immediately. Old links don’t get re-activated by re-sharing — you get a fresh link each time.
support.q6: My Splitwise connection expired — what now?
support.a6: Open your dashboard; if it says “connection expired”, press reconnect to authorize again. Public pages keep serving the last snapshot in the meantime.
support.a7: No. SplitViewer is an independent, open-source tool that uses Splitwise’s public API. Splitwise is a trademark of its respective owner.
support.a8: In a Cloudflare D1 database restricted to European Union jurisdiction (including Europe-only storage regions).
support.reportTitle: Report a problem or request a takedown
support.reportBody: Found a link that shouldn’t be public, or a privacy concern? Report it privately — never post a share link in a public issue. Share owners can always revoke instantly themselves from the dashboard.
support.projectBody: Want to help? See the contributing guide. Currently on the roadmap: dashboard UX polish, multi-language support (starting with Italian), and long-term link management features.
